verses.zh: 比撒列用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线做精致的衣服，在圣所用以供职，又为亚伦做圣衣，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.en: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made woven garments for serving in the sanctuary; they made holy garments that were for Aaron, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.[NOTE:1]
notes: This chapter also will be almost identical to the instructions given earlier, with a few changes along the way.

verses.zh: 他用金线和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做以弗得；
verses.en: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet yarn, and fine twisted linen.

verses.zh: 把金子锤成薄片，剪出线来，与蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，用巧匠的手工一同绣上。
verses.en: They hammered the gold into thin sheets and cut it into narrow strips to weave[NOTE:1] them into the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and into the fine linen, the work of an artistic designer.
notes: The verb is the infinitive that means “to do, to work.” It could be given a literal rendering: “to work [them into] the blue….” Weaving or embroidering is probably what is intended.

verses.zh: 又为以弗得做两条相连的肩带，接连在以弗得的两头。
verses.en: They made shoulder pieces for it, attached to two of its corners, so it could be joined together.

verses.zh: 其上巧工织的带子和以弗得一样的做法，用以束上，与以弗得接连一块，是用金线和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做的，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.en: The artistically woven waistband of the ephod that was on it was like it, of one piece with it,[NOTE:1] of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
notes: Heb “from it” or the same.

verses.zh: 又琢出两块红玛瑙，镶在金槽上，彷佛刻图书，按着以色列儿子的名字雕刻；
verses.en: They set the onyx stones in gold filigree settings, engraved as with the engravings of a seal[NOTE:1] with the names of the sons of Israel.[NOTE:2]
notes: Or “as seals are engraved.”
The twelve names were those of Israel’s sons. The idea was not the remembrance of the twelve sons as such, but the twelve tribes that bore their names.

verses.zh: 将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人做纪念石，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.en: He put[NOTE:1] them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as stones of memorial for the Israelites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
notes: Or “attached.”

verses.zh: 他用巧匠的手工做胸牌，和以弗得一样的做法，用金线与蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做的。
verses.en: He made the breastpiece, the work of an artistic designer, in the same fashion as the ephod, of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine twisted linen.

verses.zh: 胸牌是四方的，叠为两层；这两层长一虎口，宽一虎口，
verses.en: It was square—they made the breastpiece doubled, nine inches long and nine inches wide when doubled.

verses.zh: 上面镶着宝石四行：第一行是红宝石、红璧玺、红玉；
verses.en: They set on it[NOTE:1] four rows of stones: a row with a ruby, a topaz, and a beryl—the first row;
notes: That is, they set in mountings.

verses.zh: 第二行是绿宝石、蓝宝石、金钢石；
verses.en: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

verses.zh: 第三行是紫玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶；
verses.en: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

verses.zh: 第四行是水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉。这都镶在金槽中。
verses.en: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold filigree settings.

verses.zh: 这些宝石都是按着以色列十二个儿子的名字，彷佛刻图书，刻十二个支派的名字。
verses.en: The stones were for the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, corresponding to the number of[NOTE:1] their names. Each name corresponding to one of the twelve tribes was like the engravings of a seal.
notes: The phrase “the number of” has been supplied.

verses.zh: 在胸牌上，用精金拧成如绳子的链子。
verses.en: They made for the breastpiece braided chains like cords of pure gold,

verses.zh: 又做两个金槽和两个金环，安在胸牌的两头。
verses.en: and they made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and they attached the two rings to the upper[NOTE:1] two ends of the breastpiece.
notes: Here “upper” has been supplied.

verses.zh: 把那两条拧成的金链子穿过胸牌两头的环子，
verses.en: They attached the two gold chains to the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece;

verses.zh: 又把链子的那两头接在两槽上，安在以弗得前面肩带上。
verses.en: the other[NOTE:1] two ends of the two chains they attached to the two settings, and they attached them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front of it.
notes: Here “other” has been supplied.

verses.zh: 做两个金环，安在胸牌的两头，在以弗得里面的边上，
verses.en: They made two rings of gold and put them on the other[NOTE:1] two ends of the breastpiece on its edge, which is on the inner side of the ephod.[NOTE:2]
notes: Here “other” has been supplied.
Heb “homeward side.”

verses.zh: 又做两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，挨近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。
verses.en: They made two more[NOTE:1] gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the juncture above the waistband of the ephod.
notes: Here “more” has been supplied.

verses.zh: 用一条蓝细带子把胸牌的环子和以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不可与以弗得离缝，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.en: They tied the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod by blue cord, so that it was above the waistband of the ephod, so that the breastpiece would not be loose from the ephod, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.zh: 他用织工做以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。
verses.en: He made the robe of the ephod completely blue, the work of a weaver.

verses.zh: 袍上留一领口，口的周围织出领边来，彷佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。
verses.en: There was an opening in the center of the robe, like the opening of a collar,[NOTE:1] with an edge all around the opening so that it could not be torn.
notes: See the note on this word in Exod 28:32 for discussion of its meaning.

verses.zh: 在袍子底边上，用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做石榴，
verses.en: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and twisted linen[NOTE:1] around the hem of the robe.
notes: The word is simply “twined” or “twisted.” It may refer to the twisted linen that so frequently is found in these lists; or, it may refer to the yarn twisted. The LXX reads “fine twined linen.” This is not found in the text of Exod 28:33, except in Smr and LXX.

verses.zh: 又用精金做铃铛，把铃铛钉在袍子周围底边上的石榴中间：
verses.en: They made bells of pure gold and attached the bells between the pomegranates around the hem of the robe between the pomegranates.

verses.zh: 一个铃铛一个石榴，一个铃铛一个石榴，在袍子周围底边上用以供职，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.en: There was[NOTE:1] a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, all around the hem of the robe, to be used in ministering,[NOTE:2] just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
notes: The words “there was” are supplied in the translation for stylistic reasons.
The infinitive “to minister” is present; “to be used” is supplied from the context.

verses.zh: 他用织成的细麻布为亚伦和他的儿子做内袍，
verses.en: They made tunics of fine linen—the work of a weaver, for Aaron and for his sons—

verses.zh: 并用细麻布做冠冕和华美的裹头巾，用捻的细麻布做裤子，
verses.en: and the turban of fine linen, the headbands of fine linen, and the undergarments of fine twisted linen.

verses.zh: 又用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻，以绣花的手工做腰带，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.en: The sash was of fine twisted linen and blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, the work of an embroiderer, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.zh: 他用精金做圣冠上的牌，在上面按刻图书之法，刻着「归耶和华为圣」。
verses.en: They made a plate, the holy diadem, of pure gold and wrote on it an inscription, as on the engravings of a seal, “Holiness to the Lord.”

verses.zh: 又用一条蓝细带子将牌系在冠冕上，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.en: They attached to it a blue cord to attach it to the turban above, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.zh: 帐幕，就是会幕，一切的工就这样做完了。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照样做了。
verses.en: [NOTE:1] So all the work of the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, was completed, and the Israelites did according to all that the Lord had commanded Moses—they did it exactly so.
notes: The last sections of the book bring several themes together to a full conclusion. Not only is it the completion of the tabernacle, it is the fulfillment of God’s plan revealed at the beginning of the book, i.e., to reside with his people.

verses.zh: 他们送到摩西那里。帐幕和帐幕的一切器具，就是钩子、板、闩、柱子、带卯的座，
verses.en: They brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its furnishings, clasps, frames, bars, posts, and bases;

verses.zh: 染红公羊皮的盖、海狗皮的顶盖，和遮掩柜的幔子，
verses.en: and the coverings of ram skins dyed red, the covering of fine leather,[NOTE:1] and the protecting[NOTE:2] curtain;
notes: See the note on this phrase in Exod 25:5.
Or “shielding” (NIV); NASB “the screening veil.”

verses.zh: 法柜和柜的杠并施恩座，
verses.en: the ark of the testimony and its poles, and the atonement lid;

verses.zh: 桌子和桌子的一切器具并陈设饼，
verses.en: the table, all its utensils, and the Bread of the Presence;

verses.zh: 精金的灯台和摆列的灯盏，与灯台的一切器具，并点灯的油，
verses.en: the pure[NOTE:1] lampstand, its lamps, with the lamps set in order, and all its accessories, and oil for the light;
notes: Possibly meaning “pure gold lampstand.”

verses.zh: 金坛、膏油、馨香的香料、会幕的门帘，
verses.en: and the gold altar, and the anointing oil, and the fragrant incense; and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;

verses.zh: 铜坛和坛上的铜网，坛的杠并坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
verses.en: the bronze altar and its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils; the large basin with its pedestal;

verses.zh: 院子的帷子和柱子，并带卯的座，院子的门帘、绳子、橛子，并帐幕和会幕中一切使用的器具，
verses.en: the hangings of the courtyard, its posts and its bases, and the curtain for the gateway of the courtyard, its ropes and its tent pegs, and all the furnishings[NOTE:1] for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
notes: Heb “utensils, vessels.”

verses.zh: 精工做的礼服，和祭司亚伦并他儿子在圣所用以供祭司职分的圣衣。
verses.en: the woven garments for serving[NOTE:1] in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments for his sons to minister as priests.
notes: The form is the infinitive construct; it means the clothes to be used “to minister” in the Holy Place.

verses.zh: 这一切工作都是以色列人照耶和华所吩咐摩西做的。
verses.en: The Israelites did all the work according to all that the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐的，他们就怎样做了。摩西看见一切的工都做成了，就给他们祝福。
verses.en: Moses inspected[NOTE:1] all the work, and[NOTE:2] they had done it just as the Lord had commanded—they had done it exactly—and Moses blessed them.[NOTE:3]
notes: Or “examined” (NASB, TEV); NCV “looked closely at.”
The deictic particle draws attention to what he saw in such a way as to give the reader Moses’ point of view and a sense of his pleasure: “and behold, they….”
The situation and wording in Exod 39:43 are reminiscent of Gen 1:28 and 31, with the motifs of blessing people and inspecting what has been made.
